sprint: RAH3 - non-copy causal readout validation + powered behavioural bank
rule: Every paper-level claim is entered HERE before any prose is written, and no prose may say more than its ledger entry (RAH3 section 5.6). A claim with status PENDING has no prose at all.

claims.claim: At capture offset N=+1 the donor token is '.', identically on all 8 registered donors, on both models and both lexical pairs, and it violates none of the three non-copy disqualification predicates. At offset 0 the donor token IS the concept surface on 8/8 rows of every cell.
claims.scope: STRUCTURAL ONLY. Says nothing whatever about transport.
claims.population: direct_harmful / behavioral / n_examples=8, first 8 by prompt_id
claims.domains: n/a - 8 donor prompts within one pair; NOT independent domains
claims.control: offset 0 (the historical capture site) is the paired comparison
claims.estimand: token identity and three boolean predicates at the capture site
limitations: Tokenizer-only. No weights loaded, no forward pass; the probe is INCAPABLE of producing a transport number.
The banks happen to end in a fixed pair-independent trailer; the rule's validity is a property of THIS material, not of the code (rfind has no word-boundary test).
A clean structural result is NOT a preview of the transport answer.
claims.independent_verifier: scripts/rah3_verify_noncopy_independent.py (re-derives the capture site from the bank + tokenizer, importing no producer helper)

claims.claim: The non-copy capture site is implemented with nine per-row invariants and a cross-row consistency assertion, all hard-failing; 39 guard tests are green and every invariant has a paired mutation proven to make it red, except one branch shown to be unreachable at positive offsets and proven red at a negative offset instead.
claims.scope: Instrument implementation. Not a scientific result.
limitations: 39 is the GUARD-LIST count across two files, not the full suite (RAH3 section 5.9).
The default capture path remains 'surface', i.e. a copy test, by design and for historical reproduction.
claims.independent_verifier: the mutation tests themselves; each constructs a violating input and asserts refusal

claims.claim: Track B is blocked by material and power. The 38-domain bank already exists and is not the blocker; the blockers are that the only baseline cell clearing 0.1375 is the DISCOVERY pair on one model, and that rows-per-domain is 4 rather than the 16 the design needs.
claims.scope: Track B design feasibility at current material and current HEAD.
claims.estimand: minimum detectable relative effect at 80% power
claims.statistic: MDE by bisection over paired_test_noise_sensitivity.simulate, SIM_REPS=4000, alpha=0.05
limitations: MDE at 38x4 ICC=0.19 and at 20x4 (both ICCs) is null meaning NOT DETECTABLE AT ALL, including a 100% wipeout - not meaning 'small'.
ICC=0.09 has no estimator anywhere in the repository (RAH3-C-006); the 0.6899 figure must never be quoted without 0.8552 beside it.
k=38 is an UPPER BOUND on independent clusters: 3 of 38 domains are register/genre, the rest are near-identical templates from one model at one base seed (RAH3 section 11.8).
The screening truncation gate is published and never evaluated (RAH3-C-007), so no screened baseline is certified against the cap rule.
claims.independent_verifier: re-derived in the main loop by importing the module and running its own simulator; the flip-model non-monotonicity and the ICC absence were confirmed by direct source reading and grep

claims.claim: Under a NON-COPY positive control (donor captured one token off the concept surface), no exposure-clean multi-hop receiver clears the transport threshold on either model. On Llama the candidate-PRINTING reference clears it (P-B); on Qwen3 even that fails (P-D).
claims.scope: DEVELOPMENT ONLY, carrot<->bomb, direct_harmful donors. A statement about the INSTRUMENT, not about doublespeak.
claims.outcome_rule: RAH3-PR-001 section 2.8, taxonomy P-A / P-B / P-C / P-D / P-E, locked before the run
claims.selection_rule: scripts/rah3_select_config.py, committed before the artifacts exist
claims.population: direct_harmful / behavioral / n_examples=8, first 8 by prompt_id
claims.domains: n/a - 8 donor prompts, NOT independent domains
claims.intervention: none - this is a positive control, effect-blind
claims.control: the offset-0 capture (rah2pcf_*_cb) is the paired copy-test comparison, on development only
claims.estimand: p_concept at the selected cell; the four requirements
claims.statistic: selection_max over donor layer L x receiver depth R - an instrument-selection statistic, NOT an effect estimate
limitations: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. No held-out cell exists - the committed gate closed it.
ONE offset. N=+1 is a single pre-committed site, deliberately not swept. A richer non-surface site (' context' at +4) might transport more; testing it needs a NEW preregistration.
The collapse does NOT distinguish 'off-surface transport is weak' from "'.' is a poor carrier". Both are consistent with every number.
p_concept=0.1932 is selection_max over 31x5 unpenalised - an upper bound on Llama off-surface transport, not an estimate.
Qwen3's P-D is a statement about THIS ASSAY on that model, not about Qwen3.
claims.selection: scripts/rah3_select_config.py, committed at 8e9ca447 BEFORE either artifact existed
independent_verifier: scripts/rah3_verify_noncopy_independent.py: 289 checks / 0 failures on each, 17/17 mutation classes RED

claims.claim: NOT RUN - GATED OFF. The held-out (lantern<->poison) arm was not run because the committed selection script returned held_out_may_run=False after Qwen3 returned P-D.
claims.note: The held-out direct_harmful positive control has NEVER been run at any offset (the RAH2 held-out runs used natural_doublespeak donors), so this is a first measurement, unpaired and descriptive.
claims.why: Running a frozen configuration on held-out material would be measuring an instrument that failed its own development validation. Per RAH3-PR-001 section 2.9 the stopping rule is HARD.

corrections.about: a mutation test that could not be made red
corrections.summary: Two attempts at the concept-overlap mutation failed to raise. rfind anchors on the LAST occurrence, so at a POSITIVE offset any concept characters downstream would have BEEN the anchor - the branch is unreachable there. Recorded as a structural test and proven red at a negative offset instead, rather than contriving an input until it went red.

corrections.resolved: PARTIALLY - its own prescription was wrong, see RAH3-C-008
corrections.summary: A second live session committed 14 lines of RAH3's implementation inside a commit whose message is a provenance audit ending 'PR-004 unaffected'. History deliberately not rewritten.

'mass_gate': 0.05 was written into every preflight artifact and read by no code path, so requirement 2 was enforced by nothing. The Track-A headline's median option_mass of 6.96e-08 passed straight through. Now a module constant applied on the production path via cell_mass_gate_ok.

corrections.about: a patch that never applied would score as a scientific null
corrections.summary: LayerPatch skips an out-of-range position silently and exposes no n_applied. assert_run_not_vacuous now refuses to persist a sweep where the patch changed nothing anywhere, refuses an empty grid, and refuses a missing counter key.

MEASURED_FLIP_BY_ASR falls twice (22% and 23%) while its own docstring, RESEARCH_HANDOFF.md:378 and the sprint charter all say the flip rate RISES with baseline ASR. flip_for_asr also clamps above ASR 0.3125 to 0.0658, BELOW the 0.0851 maximum measured - anti-conservative at the wrong end.
The single most load-bearing input to the Track-B GO/NO-GO is an assumption with no producing script and no artifact anywhere in the repository.

corrections.about: the screening truncation gate is never evaluated
corrections.summary: max_frac_at_cap = 0.02 is published in the thresholds block; frac_cap = None is hardcoded and no qualification branch references it. A cell with 100% truncation would still report qualifies: true. Same defect class as C-003, found twice in one sprint in two files.

corrections.about: the third sweep, inside the correction for the second
corrections.summary: Commit b100c52d, titled 'RBD-C-022: I committed another writer's work', committed four RAH3 files. RAH3-C-002's prescription was WRONG: git add <path> scopes the ADD while git commit commits the whole shared index. The correct rule is git commit -- <paths>.

must_not_be_revived: id07_raw is an exposure-clean high-mass readout (retracted by RAH2-C-020; it is a 0-hop token decoder)
binding preservation is established (it is not - Llama 78->61/80, Qwen3 75->9/80)
RAH-R-018 shows transport is present or absent (it is A-IV / CANNOT ANSWER, permanently)
any max over receiver-layer x donor-layer quoted as transport strength (that is selection_max, an upper bound)
